results.name: Prism Core Valley Procedural Sci-Fi Environment
results.description:
A colorful, 60-metre sci-fi reactor set in a remote mountain valley. Glowing energy rings, metallic conduits, and layered cooling fins rise above a concrete pedestal, surrounded by pine trees, worker buildings, and parked cars that establish its enormous scale.
This first Sketchfab test explores an AI-assisted procedural workflow: art direction by Jon Tojek, with Blender Python scripts developed using OpenAI Codex. Geometry, materials, and lighting were assembled programmatically and exported as GLB for real-time viewing.
An early look-development study focused on color, scale, and browser-based presentation. Orbit around the facility and zoom in to find the workers beside the entrance stairs.

results.name: RTX 3070 TI Asus TUF
results.description:
SUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 3070 Ti

High-detail 3D model of the ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 3070 Ti graphics card, crafted with precision in Blender.

This project was built out of pure passion for hardware design and 3D modeling, capturing the industrial, rugged aesthetic of the TUF Gaming line. Every component has been meticulously modeled from reference, focusing on accurate geometry, structural details, and realistic proportions.

Key Features:

Backplate: Accurate rear layout featuring the TUF Gaming branding, ventilation cutouts, and GPU bracket details.

Cooling System: Detailed triple Axial-tech fans with individual blade curves, heat dissipation fins, and internal heat pipe structures.

Shroud & Frame: Textured metallic casing, angular cutouts, and side panel detailing with GeForce RTX and TUF logo accents.

Created for display and portfolio presentation. Modeled in Blender.

results.name: FREE [Tubes] GameReady
results.description:

The model consists of several coiled/rolled pipes placed on the ground, each built with all‑quad topology for consistent shading and optimal performance.

**Technical Details:**
- Format: GLB (with embedded textures), FBX also available
- Textures: 2K PBR (Base Color, Normal, Roughness, Metallic, AO)
- Topology: 100% Quads
- Polycount: Optimized for real‑time use (approx. 800–1,200 tris per pipe, scalable)

**Engine Compatibility:** Unreal Engine (5/4), Unity, and other PBR‑ready engines

**Usage:**
Ideal for industrial yards, construction sites, military depots, scrapyards, or as cover/decorative elements in shooters, action games, and tactical FPS. Works seamlessly with Unreal Engine’s nanite and LOD systems.
